content.text: You are one in a million, but here you’re more than a number. One of the reasons students like UNI so much: we know you by name. It’s part of what makes UNI special. From the moment you connect with Admissions through graduation day, it’s all about you, your individual interests and your personal goals. We talk to you about where you want to go, and we walk you through all the basics to get there, from simple requirements and important dates to available scholarships and an easy four-step application process. We’re with you every step of the way. Information For The most affordable public university education in Iowa An education at UNI should be available for any curious-minded student wanting to improve themselves and the world around them. So, it is no coincidence that we're one of the most affordable four-year universities in the Midwest. Applying Student Stories Why UNI If you're ready, we're ready for you.
